    Generate a synthetic mass-casualty cohort

    Source: R/synthetic.R
    sdt_synthetic_cohort.Rd

    Produces a reproducible synthetic cohort, one row per casualty, with the fields expected by sdt_scenario(). Marginals default to the published reference distributions returned by sdt_reference(), and can be overridden.

    Usage

    sdt_synthetic_cohort(
  n = 20L,
  triage_prob = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  backend = c("base", "simstudy")
)

    Arguments

    n

    Number of casualties to generate (positive whole number).

    triage_prob

    Named numeric vector of sighting-category probabilities. Defaults to the published triage mix. Need not sum to 1; it is normalised.

    seed

    Optional integer seed. Applied with withr::local_seed(), so the caller's random stream is restored on exit.

    backend

    Either "base" (always available, frozen behaviour) or "simstudy", which draws correlated age, injury severity and life points through a simstudy definition table. If simstudy is not installed, "simstudy" warns and falls back to "base".

    Value

    A cohort object (a tibble::tibble() subclass) with columns id, age, sex, life_points, ventilated, injury_region, triage, therapy, arrival_order. The "simstudy" backend additionally carries iss, an injury-severity proxy.

    See also

    sdt_synthesise() to synthesise from a real seed cohort instead.

    Examples

    sdt_synthetic_cohort(n = 10, seed = 42)
#> # A cohort: 10 casualties
#> # Triage:   red: 2 yellow: 3 green: 5
#>    id      age sex   life_points ventilated injury_region triage therapy
#>    <chr> <int> <chr>       <int> <lgl>      <chr>         <chr>  <chr>  
#>  1 P001     52 m               3 FALSE      thorax        yellow none   
#>  2 P002     38 m               4 FALSE      thorax        yellow TASC   
#>  3 P003      2 m               1 FALSE      thorax        red    DCS    
#>  4 P004      5 f               4 FALSE      multiple      yellow none   
#>  5 P005     62 m               5 FALSE      head          green  none   
#>  6 P006     37 f               5 FALSE      head          green  none   
#>  7 P007     15 f               6 FALSE      extremity     green  none   
#>  8 P008     39 m               2 FALSE      multiple      red    DCS    
#>  9 P009     60 m               6 FALSE      thorax        green  none   
#> 10 P010     70 m               6 FALSE      head          green  TASC   
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: arrival_order <int>

# Override the mix to stress the red pathway.
sdt_synthetic_cohort(
  n = 10, triage_prob = c(red = 0.8, yellow = 0.2), seed = 1
)
#> # A cohort: 10 casualties
#> # Triage:   red: 7 yellow: 3 green: 0
#>    id      age sex   life_points ventilated injury_region triage therapy
#>    <chr> <int> <chr>       <int> <lgl>      <chr>         <chr>  <chr>  
#>  1 P001     41 m               1 FALSE      head          red    DCS    
#>  2 P002     42 f               1 TRUE       abdomen       red    TASC   
#>  3 P003     56 m               1 TRUE       abdomen       red    TASC   
#>  4 P004     54 m               3 FALSE      extremity     yellow TASC   
#>  5 P005     51 m               1 FALSE      abdomen       red    TASC   
#>  6 P006     56 m               4 FALSE      head          yellow TASC   
#>  7 P007     54 m               4 FALSE      extremity     yellow TASC   
#>  8 P008     43 m               2 FALSE      multiple      red    TASC   
#>  9 P009     12 f               2 TRUE       head          red    DCS    
#> 10 P010     51 m               1 FALSE      head          red    TASC   
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: arrival_order <int>
